entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Bow)

system.description: Launch a bow attack with +8 Atk and +1 Brk at the cost of -3 Acc. This attack cannot perform Extra Attacks.
Protected from Slashing damage. Vulnerable to Piercing, Lightning and Arcane damage.

A bow reliant on the marksman's strength and skill. Delivers incredible results for the talented archer.

Effective against Flying units.
